high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "theworldofscience.co." The post features a photograph of Earth viewed from space, with a clear blue sky above and clouds below. The curvature of the Earth is visible, indicating that the photo was taken from a high altitude, possibly from a satellite or a high-flying aircraft. The text overlay on the image reads: "Earth is swallowing up more carbon from its atmosphere than previously thought, new research reveals.
